title: Règne Delta launches Friday 6 November, 3 days to go
detail: Worldwide release 6 Nov, with the online game getting it a day earlier on 5 Nov. Mega Rayquaza ex is the headliner. Sources disagree on when the in-store prerelease window ends (1 Nov or 5 Nov), so check with your shop.

title: Miyata Kard Market: still only the 6 Nov date, no products or stock listed
detail: Home page still shows 'Date de Sortie 06/11/2026' for ME06, with no products, pre-orders or stock visible this morning. Worth asking the shop directly about allocations.

title: OP-18: Bandai's product pages reportedly give 21 Nov (Japan) and 20 Nov (English)
detail: A retailer blog quoting Bandai's official pages (checked 1 Oct) says Japan 21 Nov, English 20 Nov, ¥240 / $4.99 per pack. Earlier X post said 22 Nov. I could not open Bandai's pages myself, so this is still second-hand. The Japanese date on the Calendar stays marked unconfirmed.

title: Mega Darkrai ex SIR (Pitch Black) is steady: no big move
detail: Cardmarket 7-day average €180 vs 30-day €184, trend about €168 (updated 2 Nov). Well under the 20% threshold, so no alert.

title: Regionals in Porto and Sydney this Saturday, 7 November
detail: Still upcoming; no results yet. First big events since the Mihawk ban. Pokémon: nothing finished since yesterday.

title: Price checks only partly possible today
detail: TCGdex returned no Cardmarket prices for the 30th Celebration cards (Mew ex 152, Pikachu ex 150), and the collection file has no card IDs, so I could only check Darkrai. Yesterday's anniversary-set drops still stand but are not updated.
